Ben / team —

Thanks for the heads-up. I reviewed Nimbus_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf and the broker notes. My read and recommendations below: 

- Additional Insured naming: “Redwood Inference, Inc. and its affiliates” is fine. Ensure the endorsement is CG 20 10 or equivalent so contractual liability is covered — request the carrier confirm the endorsement form.
- Coverage minima: Accept the 1M/2M GL and 1M E&O for this order form. If risk team pushes back on E&O exposure we’ll revisit, but for the current SOW set we can proceed.
- Waiver of subrogation: do NOT accept a customer-side waiver of subrogation language that shifts recovery away from insurers; ask Nimbus to remove that clause or limit it to claims arising from their negligence.
- Data-processing exclusion: redline out the expansion to GL that excludes data-related claims; we should retain third-party cyber coverage where available.

Action items for Ben / Neha:
1) Ask Nimbus broker to confirm endorsement form and attach the COI with endorsement text (we need the endorsement, not just a COI).
2) If broker cannot provide the endorsement text within 3 business days, ask for a carrier letter confirming willingness to issue the endorsement when requested.
3) I will mark the MSA redline doc with one-line comments and share via Drive; if there are any contract clauses beyond insurance we should escalate.

If Nimbus pushes hard on an aggressive indemnity or a sweeping data exclusion, we should loop legal + risk for a call. Otherwise proceed with the proposed MAP.
